about: Inputs for tools/estate_power.py. Pop weights and building bonuses are from the 1.4.5 game files; the country modifiers are read off Trent's estate-power tooltips at a reading; the promotion term is fitted. See tools/README.md, 'Estate power'.

1337-11-16.source: Trent's estate-power tooltips at the moment of SP_GRA_1337_11_16

1340-05-02.source: Trent's estate power panel on 2 May 1340 (shares only), calibrated on the 1 May 1340 autosave. Country modifiers are those of the 16 November 1337 tooltips with the debt penalty (crown -65.81%) folded in; not re-read. The loss of the Catalan Merchant Privileges at the declaration of war (nobles +20%, burghers +10%) is folded in as well.

1340-08-11.source: Trent's Dhimmī power tooltip on 11 August 1340, the day of the peace save: 140.53 of a total 961.60 political power (14.61%). The per-group breakdown matches powerPerPop x (1 + 0.73) exactly (Allow Military Service +10%, Promote Tolerance +20%, Grant Administrative Posts +10%, Pact of Umar +33%), with no local or promotion term. Other estates not read: they keep the relative corrections of 1340-05-02, scaled so the total matches.

1349-06-01.source: Trent's estates panel on 1 June 1349 (shares only, whole percents), calibrated on the 4 June 1349 save three days later. Country modifiers are those of the 1340-08-11 reading with every dated adjustment since folded in (Catalan privileges restored, royal decree, Favor the Ruler).

adjustments.source: Trent's screenshot: 'Impact of Debt to the Estate', crown power -65.81% with 1,351.73 owed to the estates. Scales with the debt; replace with the figure at each later reading.

eu5db.com (1.4.5): catalan_merchant_privileges gives nobles power -20% and burghers power -10% and needs peace with Aragon; Granada had it until the declaration of 24 May 1339 (in that day's save, gone by 2 September 1339). Its crown term scales with Farfanes in the army and Granada had none.
